id.description: Unique id; edges name it in from / to.

kind.description: start (where the flow begins), question (a decision, drawn as a numbered diamond), outcome (where it ends), step (something done on the way).

label.description: The text in the node: one short question or outcome. No ids, file names or endpoints.

state.description: A question's answer source — the stored fact that decides it (a file, a setting, a field, an id). Shown in the State panel under the question's number.

note.description: A detail a reader needs but the flow does not turn on. Shown on hover and in the Notes panel.

ref.description: Another chart (by name, any format): drawn as Open ↗ on the node.
